## Personality

A capable, clever, and hardworking manager, this woman manages her own affairs as well as those of others. Known as a good Christian and a red-hot politician, she is a kind, kindly, and good soul at heart who regularly helps the poor. She is nevertheless an officious, curious, and critical figure who loves to give advice, nag people to do right, and pride herself on speaking her mind outspokenly. Extremely observant and farseeing, she acts as a shrewd judge of human nature, though she is also pessimistic and holds prejudices against those raised outside of Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island). In her beliefs, she is firmly opposed to horse racing on religious grounds and strongly maintains that everything is foreordained. Additionally, she possesses notable skills in sewing as well as making butter and cheese.

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde, a longtime neighbor of [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), observed [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) leaving home unexpectedly and visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to investigate, where she voiced strong skepticism upon learning the siblings intended to adopt a young boy. She later visited again and insulted the adopted child, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), prompting a passionate outburst from the girl; after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatically apologized, Mrs. Lynde readily forgave her. Over the following years, Mrs. Lynde kept close tabs on Anne's progress, sewing a green dress with puffed sleeves for Anne's [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert when [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) sought her help, and praising Anne's physical and academic growth to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Following the sudden death of [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Lynde informed [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) had offered to give up the local school teaching post so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could stay near home. As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) began her teaching career in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Mrs. Lynde advised against establishing the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) and routinely exchanged village gossip with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), later noting approvingly when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) won over a troublemaking student with corporal punishment. When Mrs. Lynde's husband [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) passed away, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) invited the widowed neighbor to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to live with her.

## Quotes

> "She’s terrible skinny and homely, Marilla. Come here, child, and let me have a look at you. Lawful heart, did any one ever see such freckles? And hair as red as carrots! Come here, child, I say."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)

> "Child, yes, I’m afraid of it. Look at his face. When you’ve seen that look as often as I have you’ll know what it means."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P7](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0007)

> "I saw Mr. Harrison chasing your Jersey out of his oats today when I was coming home from Carmody. I thought he looked pretty mad. Did he make much of a rumpus?"
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038)

> "I knew there’d be trouble when Robert Bell sold his place to a New Brunswick man, that’s what. I don’t know what Avonlea is coming to, with so many strange people rushing into it. It’ll soon not be safe to go to sleep in our beds."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P43](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0043)

> "I’m not supposed to know anything about her arrival, and Mr. Harrison was to bring some medicine for Thomas from Carmody today, so that will be a good excuse. I’ll find out the whole story and come in and tell you on the way back."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P32](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0032)

## Relationships

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Rachel Lynde are close friends and long-time [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) neighbors who often visit each other to share local gossip and offer practical advice. While Rachel frequently voices strong opinions and skepticism about Marilla's household decisions, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) relies on her counsel for managing difficulties, such as Anne's upbringing. Their close relationship extends to shared social outings, including traveling together to a political rally.

### [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

[Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) is the husband of Rachel Lynde. While Rachel remains heavily involved in neighborhood affairs and local discussions at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) is part of her domestic life in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel Lynde initially offends [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) by criticizing her looks, leading to a dramatic outburst from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eventually offers a theatrical apology that earns Rachel's forgiveness. Over time, Rachel's opinion of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) softens as she observes her dramatic growth, beauty, and success as a schoolteacher. The two evolve into friendly neighbors who interact regularly over daily household requests and community news.

- Friend of — neighbors and acquaintances who interact over household requests (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P25](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0025)</sub>

### [Emily](../character/emily.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel Lynde acts as a neighbor and acquaintance to [Emily](../character/emily.md) [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) following Emily's arrival in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to reconcile with her husband, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). Rachel actively investigates the circumstances surrounding the couple's past separation, later spending time chatting with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and remaining involved in their social circle.

- Friend of — neighbors and shopping companions (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P5](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0005)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel Lynde takes a keen, fond interest in the lives and progress of Anne's young pupils, including [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md).
